top_choice_rationale: P001 honours a mature, independently validated discovery chain: Holst on GLP-1 secretion and the incretin effect, Mojsov on the biologically active GLP-1(7-36) peptide, and Drucker on receptor biology and therapeutic rationale. Randomized trials in type 2 diabetes, obesity and cardiovascular and renal outcomes confirm the mechanism and durable benefit. The citation names physiology and the active form as the discovery and therapy as its consequence, which makes the three-person allocation principled. The attribution costs (Knudsen's long-acting agonists, Mojsov's contested priority against Habener) are real but do not outweigh the case for an award over no award.
